smallest_supported_claim: The isolated, source- and executable-bound setup run reached 11:00 PM through the advertised numeric prompt and activated the carried smartphone flashlight through advertised native inventory/menu actions. It did not establish a saved nighttime copy or any ordinary nighttime gameplay account.
causal_account: The bound native prompt accepted the clock value and the later World observation records game_minutes 8580 (11:00 PM). The carried smartphone was selected from inventory and its advertised Turn on flashlight command was accepted natively. The ordinary flashlight was explicitly uncharged, so it was not represented as a successful light source. After the journal sealed actions before save, the harness rejected World save/quit; exact-PID GUI input did not change the native World surface. Therefore no native save/menu-quit proof exists and the setup profile must not seed an ordinary account.

citations.meaning: identifies the isolated night-setup scenario and its bound runtime identities
the native numeric hour prompt advertised only prompt.submit and prompt.cancel
the advertised prompt.submit action was accepted natively
the carried smartphone was selected through native inventory
the advertised smartphone menu command was accepted natively
the final native World observation was at game minute 8580 with no visible entities and no interruption
the setup run records zero-credit scope and released unused authority for terminalization

material_deviations: The originally spawned ordinary flashlight had zero charges; the carried smartphone flashlight app was used instead through its advertised native menu.
The journal action sealed the harness before native save/quit. Exact-PID GUI input delivery was attempted after that seal but did not change the native World surface.

contradictions.meaning: No native save or main-menu quit receipt was captured before terminalization, so no durable setup copy or ordinary-night account is claimed.

remaining_unknowns: Whether a fresh setup run can execute native Save and Quit before any journal seal.
The separate ordinary nighttime account remains intentionally uncreated.
